description.value: Jim's Place Pizza is a family-owned Vernon institution that has been serving specialty pizzas, pasta, and ribs for over 20 years. The menu spans creative options like Dill Pickle Pizza and Hot Honey Hawaiian alongside classics, with both dine-in and pick-up ordering available. A solid calorie-stop for cyclists passing through the Okanagan on routes in or around Vernon.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms OSM data: address (1600 – 32nd Street, Vernon, BC V1T 5K5), phone ((250) 549-3700), and website URL all match. The menu page confirms a Vegetarian pizza option and the front page explicitly offers pick-up/takeout ordering. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, charging, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field omits postal code; website provides full address as '1600 – 32nd Street, Vernon, BC V1T 5K5' — used website version.
None of the three required WWC criteria can be confirmed from available evidence; direct outreach recommended.
